description: Issue #182 (2): a CONTEXT heading excepts an issue NUMBER exactly as #54 made it except a path. #34 writes "旧本文には depends on #33 と書いてあったが、これは成立しない" under `## 根拠` — a line written to DENY a dependency — and 0.27.0 read it as one, so #34 waited a whole wave for an issue it had just said it does not depend on (measured 2026-08-07, #33/#34). The denial is now read as a citation and #34 moves to wave 1. Both directions are pinned in one case: #33's `## 依存 - depends on #31` sits outside any context span and STAYS an edge, so the rule cannot be widened into "a body that has a 根拠 section has no dependencies" without turning this case red.
